notes.Move: The worker takes the store on its next poll. If WPF is mid-pass, the worker waits for it.
notes.HandBack: The worker finishes its current chunk, then lets go. WPF takes the store on its next job firing.
notes.Pause: Both loops stop at the next chunk boundary. The store stays on the worker.
notes.RetryNow: Clears the connect backoff, puts the store first in both loops and runs housekeeping (DDL and failed scripts).
notes.ConnectionTest: Runs from the worker's own network. The result shows here and on the Commands page.
